description:
ProctorWrap HTR (High Tensile Roof / High Temperature Roof) is a
heavy-weight, UV-stabilised 3-ply spunbonded polyolefin vapour-permeable roof
underlay reinforced with an internal grid scrim. Specifically engineered for
commercial and residential pitched roofs under metal sheeting, slate, and tiles,
it provides high water holdout and tear resistance without compromising
breathability. By allowing moisture vapour to escape the roof cavity into a
drained and vented space, it protects structural timbers and insulation from
condensation damage.
features:
Heavy-weight 3-ply spunbonded polyolefin
construction with internal reinforcement scrim

Class 4 vapour-permeable
membrane allowing moisture vapour to escape roof spaces

Medium Duty
classification with exceptional tear and puncture resistance

High water
holdout protecting framing and insulation from roof leaks and rain ingress

Suitable underneath metal sheet, cement, terracotta, and natural slate tiled
roofs
Withstands high foot traffic and wind loads during construction
Non-reflective surface eliminates glare on site during daytime installation

Suitable for use in bushfire BAL regions 12.5 to 40 in accordance with
AS 3959

UV-stabilised formulation offering extended durability during roof
installation

with reinforcement scrim

mm width x 50 m length (75 m²)

compliance:

install:
Roll out ProctorWrap HTR horizontally across rafters or trusses
starting from the eaves with printed face upward

Ensure lower edge drains
freely into the roof gutter without creating a reverse lap or water trap

Allow a nominal 40mm drape between framing members to facilitate drainage and
ventilation beneath battens

Overlap consecutive upper sheets over lower
sheets by at least 150mm

Secure temporarily with broad-headed galvanised
clouts, staples, or PlastiGrip washers before fixing battens

Tape all laps
and penetrations with ProctorWrap HighTack PLUS Tape for enhanced airtightness
and weather sealing

Provide a ventilated and drained cavity between the outer
membrane face and the underside of roof cladding

Ensure compliant metal ember
guard mesh is installed at ridges, valleys, and eaves in BAL zones
selection_checklist:

terracotta tile, or slate

Verify need for Class 4 vapour-permeable roof
underlay to manage condensation risk

drained, ventilated cavity above the membrane

lap and penetration sealing

limits prior to roof covering

rag_summary:
ProctorWrap HT (ProctorWrap HTR) is a
heavy-duty, reinforced 3-ply spunbonded polyolefin vapour-permeable roof
underlay manufactured for commercial and residential pitched roofs. Sized
at 1500mm x 50m (75 m² per roll) with a Medium Duty classification, it
withstands high construction foot traffic and wind loads under metal deck, tile,
and slate roofs. Class 4 vapour-permeable, highly water-resistant, and
fire-tested to AS 1530.2 (BAL 12.5-40 compliant), it exhausts roof cavity
moisture into a ventilated airspace to prevent condensation and structural
timber rot.

description:
ProctorWrap HighTack PLUS Tape is a premium single-sided
pressure-sensitive adhesive tape engineered with an aggressive acrylic adhesive
on a durable, semi-transparent carrier. Designed primarily to repair, bond, and
seal overlaps and joins of external vapour-permeable and internal vapour/air
retarder construction membranes, it delivers a minimum tested peel adhesion of
at least 45 N / 25 mm. Its enhanced pliability and thin carrier prevent the tape
from skipping over creases in membranes while providing superior resistance to
heat, UV exposure, and adhesive edge bleed.
features:
High peel adhesion
with tested minimum bond strength of ≥ 45 N / 25 mm

Semi-transparent carrier
allows clear visibility of printed membrane alignment lines

Pliable, thin
carrier prevents skipping over creases and folds in building wraps

Aggressive
acrylic adhesive delivers immediate, permanent grab to multiple substrates
Enhanced resistance to heat and UV radiation with minimal adhesive edge bleed

Provides an airtight and weathertight seal across membrane overlaps and
penetrations

Bonds to polyolefin membranes, foil facings, timber, steel, and
clean concrete

Aids in achieving continuous building envelope airtightness
for energy efficiency

Ensure membrane surfaces and substrates are clean,
dry, and free of grease, dust, and release agents

Allow damp or cold
substrates to dry and reach application temperatures between +5°C and +40°C

Centre the 60mm tape squarely over the membrane overlap, seam, or penetration
interface

Ensure the membrane is supported from behind when applying the
tape

Apply firm pressure along the entire tape length using a plastic
squeegee or pressure roller

Smooth down edges firmly to activate the
pressure-sensitive adhesive bond and eliminate air bubbles

Ensure all
mechanical loads on membranes are carried by mechanical fixings, not the tape

description:
The ProctorWrap PlastiGrip is a 45mm diameter polypropylene
washer designed for the mechanical attachment of building wraps and rigid
insulation boards to timber and steel framing. Engineered with a flat base,
flexible perimeter, and a 5mm deep cupped head, it distributes clamping force
over a wide area to eliminate tear-out and wind blow-offs compared to
traditional staples. Tested in conjunction with ProctorWrap and ProctorPassive
membranes for calculating fixing span tables, it provides a weather-tight,
airtight mechanical anchor for high-wind building envelopes.

Rockwool Reflective represents
stone wool (mineral wool) insulation blankets or slabs laminated with reflective
aluminium foil facings for thermal, acoustic, and passive fire control.

lagging, HVAC duct wrap, and commercial building envelopes requiring combined
fire resistance and condensation control.

Sonata Recital

panels engineered specifically for semi-exposed acoustic applications. Designed
to absorb sound across a broad range of frequencies, Recital Core reduces
reverberation, controls echo, and improves speech clarity in internal commercial
and industrial building environments. Featuring a firm surface finish with a
soft sound-absorbing core, the panels are lightweight, non-allergenic, and easy
to handle behind perforated wall and ceiling linings.

high-performance thermally bonded polyester sound-absorbing boards manufactured

rag_summary:
Stinger Accessory encompasses the proprietary collated
fasteners, plastic caps, and maintenance components manufactured for STINGER cap
systems by National Nail Corp. Centered on the StaplePac and NailPac product
lines, these accessories deliver full 25mm (1 inch) diameter plastic caps

description:
The STINGER CH38-2 is an award-winning, non-pneumatic cap hammer
tacker engineered to deliver the superior holding power of a plastic cap
combined with the speed and simplicity of a manual hammer tacker. Specifically
designed for securing housewrap, synthetic roofing underlayment, and rolled
insulation, it automatically feeds and drives a full 25mm plastic cap with
a 10mm crown staple with every swing. By eliminating compressors and hoses, it
provides an economical, portable solution that seals fastener penetrations and
prevents tearing in windy conditions.
features:

tacker delivering both a plastic cap and staple in a single strike
High-capacity magazine holds 168 plastic collated caps and 168 staples

Drives full 25mm (1 inch) diameter plastic caps with 10mm (3/8 inch) crown
staples

Eliminates the cost, weight, and setup of air compressors, hoses, and
power cords

Caps create a seal over staple penetrations to prevent water and
moisture ingress

Significantly reduces blow-offs, tearing, and lateral
slippage of building wraps and felts

Lightweight 1.17 kg ergonomic design
reduces arm fatigue during all-day use

Easy trigger-advance cap mechanism
prepares each cap instantly for driving

description:

certified for IBHS FORTIFIED Roof standards, it provides maximum holding power
and seals fastener penetrations against water intrusion.

body with long service life; 100% recyclable HDPE caps and steel nails
install:
Connect CN100B tool to a clean, dry, regulated compressed air
supply set between 70 and 100 psi

Open the nail canister and load a 200-nail
coil of STINGER 25mm ring-shank nails

Open the cap basket, load a 200-cap
reel of 25mm collated plastic caps, and feed into the guide track

Close and
latch both magazines securely

Select desired firing mode: bumpfire for high
production speed or sequential for single-shot precision

Position the
nosepiece perpendicular against the roof underlayment or housewrap over timber
substrate

Depress safety contact and actuate trigger to drive the cap nail
flush against the membrane

Adjust the tool-free depth-of-drive wheel so caps
seat firmly without overdriving or crushing
selection_checklist:
Confirm project requires ring-shank nail holding power (mandatory in high-wind
and coastal zones)

Ensure regulated jobsite compressed air supply (70-100
psi) is available

Choose nail coating: electro-galvanized or 304 stainless
steel NailPac based on corrosion environment

Order matching STINGER 25mm
NailPac fastener coils (#136260 or #136262)
limitations: Requires an air compressor and pneumatic hose on site

Must
only be operated with genuine STINGER 25mm NailPac fasteners

For timber
substrates only; not designed for steel framing or solid concrete
warranty: 1-year limited warranty backed by National Nail Corp
problem_keywords: roof underlayment tearing off in high wind

hand nailing caps on
steep roofs
use_cases:
Rapid
pneumatic fastening of synthetic underlayment, roofing felt, and ice barriers to
timber roof decks in high-wind and coastal regions

Securing commercial and
residential weather-resistive barriers (housewrap) against strong winds before
cladding

Installing roof underlayment to meet IBHS FORTIFIED Roof and Florida
Building Code high-wind standards
rag_summary:
The STINGER CN (CN100B) is a
high-speed pneumatic cap nailer manufactured by National Nail for securing
synthetic underlayment, roofing felt, and housewrap to timber substrates. Firing
up to 5 cap nails per second with a 200-count magazine capacity, it drives 25mm
(1 inch) plastic collated caps with 25mm ring-shank nails (loaded via STINGER
NailPac). Tested to withstand winds up to 180 mph and certified under IBHS
FORTIFIED Home standards, it prevents underlayment blow-offs and seals fastener
penetrations against water ingress.
